title: Plank

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees, then step your feet back one at a time.
steps.cue: From hands and knees, step your feet back.

steps.text: Line your shoulders up over your hands and stretch your legs out behind you.
Draw your belly in and keep one long line from your head to your heels.
steps.cue: Belly in. One long line, head to heels.

steps.text: Hold while breathing steadily, then lower your knees to the mat.
steps.cue: Hold and breathe, then lower your knees.

mistakes: Letting the hips sag toward the floor.
regression: Keep your knees on the mat.
stopIf: Lower your knees if your lower back sags or hurts, or your wrists hurt.

anatomy.why: The belly muscles stop the hips from sagging while the arms and shoulders hold you up.
